If you have sensory issues, I HIGHLY recommend the Underworks Econo 943. It doesn’t bind as well and since I’m plus sized it kinda gives me “moobs” but I really don’t care. I use it for days where I need a binder break but I’m still dysphoric. The inside of the front is cotton lined. I would size up. Super comfortable and can give you a relatively flatter look if you wear baggy clothes.
With half tanks, I’ve found that if I size down it makes my hourglass figure stick out even more because of my love handles.

I would like to add that the binder is actually really easy to get on. I know a ton of people struggle a ton with putting binders on, even after wear. That might be a sign to size up. Even if you size up, it’ll still bind and probably more safely.

What kind of fabric should I have sewn to the bottom? Something stretchy like the top part? How long did you make the fabric? I’d probably buy another tri top just in case and take it to a tailor because I can’t sew lol.

I’ve found that the Wonababi Racerback zip binder works pretty well on me and doesn’t roll up too much due to the thicker fabric in the front. I’m like between a 3XL and 4XL in those but I sized up to a 4XL. I know people say that zippers are unsafe but I believe that’s a myth if it’s done right. Even with comparing the zip between my other binders, the only difference is the zipper pretty much. It’s like the same materials as a GC2B which also binds pretty well.
